_doc: Creature moves. kind picks the behaviour (MoveBook): strike (an arc in front, toward the aim), bolt (projectiles), lunge (a dash to the aim that hits on the way and on landing), burst (an area at the user or at the aim, after a short warning, optionally in pulses), guard (a ward on the user and the trainer that soaks damage). damage is scaled by the user's power; cooldown in seconds; range in px. An element missing here is the user's own. bond: a bond move (bigger flash and shake). desc: what it does in a sentence (the tooltip adds the numbers).

badger_bite.name: Bite
badger_bite.desc: A quick bite at whatever is in front. Its auto-attack.

claw_rush.name: Claw Rush
claw_rush.desc: A wide claw swipe in front. Fast and cheap: your go-to hit.

ember_pounce.name: Ember Pounce
ember_pounce.desc: Leaps to the cursor and bursts on landing, stunning what it hits.

cinder_roar.name: Cinder Roar
cinder_roar.desc: A roar of embers all around it: hits, shoves back and stuns.

fury_spin.name: Fury Spin
fury_spin.desc: Spins in place for about a second, hitting everything around it 5 times.

honey_rage.name: Honey Rage
honey_rage.desc: Bond move. A huge blast at the cursor that stuns and throws foes back.

glint_shot.name: Glint
glint_shot.desc: A small glass bolt. Its auto-attack.

prism_shot.name: Prism Shot
prism_shot.desc: A fast glass bolt to the cursor. Short cooldown: keep firing.

shard_fan.name: Shard Fan
shard_fan.desc: Fires a fan of 5 shards toward the cursor. Great up close.

mirror_blink.name: Mirror Blink
mirror_blink.desc: Teleports to the cursor and bursts where it lands. Your escape and engage.

dazzle.name: Dazzle
dazzle.desc: A flash at the cursor after a short delay: hits and stuns everything there.

kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
kaleidoscope.desc: Bond move. A ring of 12 piercing shards in every direction.

pangolin_swipe.name: Swipe
pangolin_swipe.desc: A claw swipe in front. Its auto-attack.

tail_swipe.name: Tail Swipe
tail_swipe.desc: A wide tail sweep that knocks foes back hard.

roll_charge.name: Roll Charge
roll_charge.desc: Curls up and rolls to the cursor, hitting everything on the way.

thorn_guard.name: Thorn Guard
thorn_guard.desc: A ward on it that soaks damage for 5 s.

seed_burst.name: Seed Burst
seed_burst.desc: Seeds burst at the cursor after a short delay: damage, and heals your creature.

bloom_wall.name: Bloom Wall
bloom_wall.desc: Bond move. A big ward that heals it and blasts the foes around it.

gust_bite.name: Gust Bite
gust_bite.desc: A biting gust in front that shoves foes back.

wind_dash.name: Wind Dash
wind_dash.desc: Dashes to the cursor, hitting everything it passes.

howl.name: Howl
howl.desc: A howl around it that throws foes back and stuns briefly.

gale_shot.name: Gale Shot
gale_shot.desc: Three piercing gusts in a narrow fan.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.desc: Bond move. A whirlwind around it that hits 6 times.

tap_shot.name: Tap
tap_shot.desc: A soft echo bolt. Its auto-attack.

echo_tap.name: Echo Tap
echo_tap.desc: Two echo bolts toward the cursor.

echo_pulse.name: Echo Pulse
echo_pulse.desc: Two pulses of sound around it that shove foes away.

ghost_finger.name: Ghost Finger
ghost_finger.desc: Blinks to the cursor and taps the ground there.

screech.name: Screech
screech.desc: A screech at the cursor after a short delay: hits and stuns.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.desc: Bond move. Four pulses of sound at the cursor that keep foes stunned.

rot_spit.name: Rot Spit
rot_spit.desc: A slow, big glob of rot at the cursor.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: Lunges to the cursor and mauls what is there, stunning briefly.

stench.name: Stench
stench.desc: A cloud of stench around it that hurts 5 times.

rot_storm.name: Rot Storm
rot_storm.desc: Bond move. A huge rot blast at the cursor that stuns.
